a.lede: Elon Musk may have been overstating it when he said Nvidia’s employees “love” the ousted Jensen Huang.
a.title: Behind Jensen Huang’s exit, questions about a management style reportedly built on fear

b.title: Jensen Huang returns to applause from employees at Nvidia HQ
